notes.title: Update on Unobtainable Steam Achievements
notes.content:
Hi there, PickCrafters!

As we developed the V6 update, we had added all the new achievements to Steam that would be introduced with this update. But there were a few of them that became unobtainable as the player couldn't unlock them yet as the content is not yet available.

We went ahead and temporarily removed the following achievements so that completionists can still reach 100% completion:

[b]The End Of Part 6[/b]
[i]Use a Cosmic Essence to change the fate of the world[/i]

[b]Did You Know? Meatloaf's Made of...[/b]
[i]Discover the Meat Biome[/i]

[b]Enthroned[/b]
[i]Unlock the Throne of Ascension[/i]

For the Enthroned achievement. It is possible to unlock this Achievement, but it's very hard to do so with some of the current balance issues with Ascension that the team is investigating and will fix in a future update. Until then, we decided to remove it.

We appreciate the feedback we've received from the Community regarding this.
Stay awesome and thank you! ❤️

- Fiveamp

notes.title: Q&A with Fiveamp Team - Dev Log #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to our very first Dev Log! ːluvː

The Fiveamp Team got together and answered all of your questions.
Expect more Dev Logs in the future covering the next major update for PickCrafter... V6!

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31331773/32578c250eaa6a362f85c4820dadacd064fb35bb.png[/img]

[b]Q: What is the thing you are most looking forward to releasing and plans for the next content update after V6?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We can't wait for the Ascension Skill Tree to be released! After that, we're still not sure. Maybe a Pickaxe Creator? Maybe buildings?


[b]Q: Will there be Netherite added to PickCrafter?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes.


[b]Q: Do you plan to make collaboration with other game developers in the future? What should we expect?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We're doing a minor collaboration with Techni to add a biome to V6 based on Blightfall. Besides that, we currently got no plans.


[b]Q: What is the best Pickaxe in the game?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] There is no Pickaxe in the game that is designed to be the best. Each and every Pickaxe can be it's best in certain situations. [i]Havi's personal favorite is Yogg's Tentacle.[/i]


[b]Q: How can I get the "WHAMMY" achievement?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] This is earned by drinking the Critical Hit Potion and then tapping / clicking 10,000 times.


[b]Q: How does it feel to have worked on such a huge game that's loved by so many people?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] It's truly an honor. We are blessed to have such a passionate community that we've built for all these years. Without you guys, there is no PickCrafter. The community and the massive amount of support is still going strong and we will continue to make PickCrafter better and better with tons of new content to come! ːluvː


[b]Q: What made the development of Pickcrafter occur?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] It started out as a Pickaxe swinging type of idea, then we thought it would be cool to gamify it like Cookie Clicker. After that, we learned Unity and then marched towards the first release.


[b]Q: Will there be another exclusive PPS item for V6 like the one from V2 like the Rare Key/Legacy Relic?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] As of right now, we don't have any plans for this. But we are willing to look into this in the future.


[b]Q: I would like the blocks of the past events to be saved. For example: I play an event and when it ends, I lose all the items but when the same event returns I recover everything.[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We feel the frustration that some players have regarding this design decision. Events are something we would really love to improve on. Create more unique and fun events, better rewards, and so on. Make sure to share your ideas with us. It really matters and helps us build an amazing game and make PickCrafter stronger than ever before ːluvː


[b]Q: Will the biomes before The Sun get prestige locked or will you add new ones?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Both! The Nether, The End, and Twilight Forest will become prestige locked, but we're adding the Deep Dark, which is not.


[b]Q: What is going on at your headquarters?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Haha, we're a remote work company. We have no headquarters 😉


[b]Q: What will the Enchanted Table (that we saw it in that picture of V6) do? [/b]
[b]A:[/b] It gives you PPS. The community seems to think it's the icon for either a new skill or a new system, but really, we noticed that Obsidian (among others) had no PPS item associated with it, so we were like "what's a useful thing you can build out of obsidian in Minecraft?" Sorry to disappoint!


[b]Q: Will there be new trophy levels? If so, which ones?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] This is something we would love to revisit at some point. As of right now, it is not our focus but make sure to share all of your feedback and ideas you have regarding trophies!


[b]Q: In which month you plan to release V6?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] No timetable as of yet - we want to make sure things work and feel good from a player's perspective ːluvː


[b]Q: What are your plans after V7?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We believe you mean V6? V6, the upcoming version will be a very important release for the state of the game in general. From a developer and player standpoint. Rebalance to make the game feel more complete, and a more organized code base for us developers to make features more quickly. After V6, we have ideas of a Pickaxe Skin Creator Tool and a way to combine different parts of a Pickaxe. More details to come in the future!


[b]Q: Does the dev team like Among Us?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. In fact, we all have played several rounds together. Some of them are very sus 👀


[b]Q: Will there be any new Fiveamp members in the future?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] As we develop new games and grow bigger as a company, we definitely will be adding new people to the Fiveamp Team!


[b]Q: Will we lose all of our progress when PickCrafter V6 comes out?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] You won't be losing any of your progress!


[b]Q: How many Prestige Levels are there? The tools/armor get a new adjective in their names after every prestige up, but there aren't infinite adjectives. 
So if it is somehow infinite: How? And what happens when you have more prestige than there are adjectives? And if it's not infinite: How much time would you estimate it taking to 100% the game? What even is 100% in this game?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] What if we combine adjectives? 🤔 What if we never stop updating the game?


[b]Q: How many new biomes are you planning to put in V6?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Three biomes upon launch of V6. Much more to come after the release of V6!


[b]Q: Can I help test PickCrafter updates?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We are always looking for passionate PickCrafters who want to help us test our updates. We have betas available for all three platforms (Steam/Android/iOS). Make sure to apply if you're interested 😉


[b]Q: Are there going to be new abilities?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. We'll be teasing them over time 😉
